query: Legionnaires disease Ontario July 2025 cases outbreak public health
query_rationale: Targets Public Health Ontario, local health unit websites, and Health Canada pages using natural-language terms without over-rigid quoting. 'July 2025' is more likely to match real document text than a date-range string. Covers both 'Legionnaires disease' and 'outbreak' to capture surveillance bulletins, health alerts, and reportable disease summaries.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: Public Health Ontario situation reports, local health unit advisories, Health Canada reportable disease tables, Ontario health alerts
expected_trust_signal: Domain from ontario.ca, publichealthontario.ca, canada.ca, or named local health unit (.ca domain); official report language such as 'confirmed cases', 'reportable disease', 'health unit'

expected_trust_signal: Named journalist or news outlet, dateline in July 2025, reference to a named public health official or health unit, specific case or death count

This query targets structured data tables or downloadable datasets that may include July 2025 case counts by health unit.

expected_trust_signal: publichealthontario.ca or canada.ca domain, tabular case count data, reference to iPHIS or PHAC notifiable disease surveillance system

query_rationale: The Middlesex-London Health Unit (MLHU) is the primary reporting authority for this outbreak. Iteration 1 surfaced only the July 14 status update (66 cases, 2 deaths). MLHU typically publishes multiple dated status updates during an active outbreak (e.g., July 7, July 21, July 28, July 31). This query targets the MLHU news/updates section directly to surface all July 2025 outbreak status pages, which will provide the time-series case and death counts needed for the July 2025 window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: Middlesex-London Health Unit official outbreak status update pages (healthunit.com/news), dated July 2025, with confirmed case counts, death counts, and geographic clustering information
expected_trust_signal: healthunit.com domain, dated July 2025, official outbreak language ('cases confirmed', 'fatalities', 'outbreak declared'), reference to Middlesex-London Health Unit medical officer of health
previous_iteration_basis: iter1_q1 returned healthunit.com July 14 update (66 cases, 2 deaths); additional dated updates likely exist
